bit string types.name: octets
bit string types.description: raw data octets in the udp payload

fields.name: source port
fields.description: optional field indicates the port of the sending process; if not used a value of zero is inserted.

fields.name: destination port
fields.description: indicates the port of the receiving process.

fields.name: length
fields.description: total length of the user datagram, measured in octets.

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: the 16-bit one's complement of the one's complement sum of a pseudo header of information from the ip header, the udp header, and the data.

parsing context.name: ip protocol
parsing context.description: assumes that the internet protocol (ip) is used as the underlying protocol.

structure types.name: pseudo header

fields.name: source address
fields.description: source address from the ip header.

fields.name: destination address
fields.description: destination address from the ip header.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: protocol field from the ip header.

constraints: checksum == one's complement sum(pseudo header, udp header, data)

parsing context.name: ip headers
parsing context.description: requires ip header information for pseudo header calculation.

parsing context.name: pseudo header padding
parsing context.description: data may be padded with zero octets at the end to make a multiple of two octets.

helper functions.name: one complement sum
helper functions.description: calculate the one's complement sum used for udp checksum.

helper functions.name: pseudo header padding
helper functions.description: pad data with zero octets to make length a multiple of two octets.
